result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there are a few visual issues: horizontally clipped content in the 'Fastest near you' carousel (restaurant name and category chips cut off at the right edge) and a missing icon for the 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation, which breaks visual consistency.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge, truncating the restaurant name. While partial peeking can signal scrollability, the text truncation looks broken rather than intentional.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a fade-out gradient mask so clipped cards read as scrollable, and ensure card titles use ellipsis truncation within a defined card width instead of being cut by the viewport.

issues.description: The bottom navigation 'Orders' tab has a text label but no icon above it, unlike the Home, Search, and Profile tabs which all have icons. This creates an inconsistent and visually broken navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add an appropriate 'Orders' icon (e.g., a receipt or bag glyph) above the label to match the other navigation items.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', ...) is also clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip, which is acceptable for scroll affordance but lacks a visual cue that more chips exist.
issues.suggestion: Optionally add a subtle right-edge fade or scroll indicator to clarify that the chip list is horizontally scrollable.
